README

Fixture

Fixture is a terminal coding assistant written in Go. It edits files, runs go test, and keeps durable sessions.

Install

go install example.com/fixture@latest

fixture --help

Features

  • Exact file tools and a patch grammar
  • Durable sessions with resume and fork

About

A terminal coding assistant written in Go.
